title: H40: hub apply rule for AppDataUpdate components
description: mls-extensions-10 §4.7: an update to a component the application doesn't know is invalid. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: during Observer::process the hub's apply callback (1) applies the four tracked components via components::apply_updates; (2) for room_metadata and franking_agent strictly decodes RoomMetaUpdate / FrankingAgentUpdate and replaces with the last update (policy still refuses any franking_agent change, H29); (3) passes Remove through (policy refuses it on tracked components); (4) treats every other component (room-policy §6/§7, unknown IDs) as invalid per §4.7.
